title: Battle of Chudniv
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Chudniv", at revision 1378669876, opens: "The Battle of Chudniv took place from 27 September to 4 November 1660 during the Russo-Polish War (1654–1667), between the forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, allied with the Crimean Tatars and 1,500 Cossacks under Ivan Vyhovsky, and the Tsardom of Russia, allied with 15,000 other Cossacks under Tymish Tsytsiura. It ended with a decisive Commonwealth victory, and the treaty of Chudniv. The entire Russian army, including its commander, was taken into jasyr slavery by the Tatars." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2042800, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1660 battle during Russo-Polish War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
